title: The Merman Prince's Second-Chance Bride
description: After a brutal betrayal leaves her with nothing, she gets saved by a ruthless merman prince who offers her a second chance at life and love. Together, they're taking down everyone who ever wronged her, one satisfying revenge plot at a time. If you love intense romance, instant payback, and huge twists, you won't be able to pause this one.
